scope: Parquet row-task projection, partition merge, residual evaluation and yielded row ownership
changes: Replace map/filter/map intermediates with one scoped traversal.
Admit merged and projected row containers and property slots before construction. Evaluate residual predicates with a memory scope.
Detach accepted output payloads under the shared budget and retain charges until generator advance or close. Release scratch per row and output per batch.
Preserve ordinary output object prototypes and define special property names safely.

validation.fixture: Real Parquet file, filtered rows, duplicate projection names, binary partition payload, own __proto__ property, early iterator return and 64 KiB rejection cleanup.

tradeoffs: Detaching accepted payloads increases copy work and overlapping live charges; it establishes independent output backing while preserving configured admission limits. No speedup claim is made.
remaining: Column-task materialization/gather/projection fallback admission is not addressed by this change.
Task planning metadata and topology allocations still require review.
Full current-revision release gates and complete 64/128 MiB mixed-job validation remain open.
Reservation accounting does not establish a whole-process or production Cloudflare heap cap.
